statement: Fix the analytic data just described, a fixed affine ambient space with coordinates (a, U), and an algebraic ambient locus X in that space. Let h, d ≥ 2, let Ψ(h) = 1 + (log h)c for a fixed c ≥ 1, and let z∗ = (a∗, U∗) ∈ X(Q) with a∗ ̸= 0. Suppose that the following bounds hold, with fixed polynomials Qi having nonnegative coefficients. (i) The ambient locus has equations of degree at most Q0(d) and affine height at most Q0(d)Ψ(h), and h(z∗) ≤ Q0(d)h. 11 (ii) There is a finite weighted selection V of places or embeddings for which |a∗|v < 1 and Ssmall := X v∈V wv log 1 |a∗|v ≥ h Q1(d) , X v∈V wv log max(1, ∥U∗∥v) ≤ Q2(d)Ψ(h). (3.2) If the second argument occurs, |R∗|v = 1 for these local data. (iii) A common list of fixed length s of allowed expressions Eν(a, U) = X j≥0 aj eνj(U), 1 ≤ ν ≤ s, vanishes at z∗ at every selected local datum. Its coefficients satisfy deg eνj ≤ C(1 + j), h((eνj)ν, 0≤j≤l) ≤ Q3(l, d)Ψ(h). There are bv ≥ 0 with P v∈V wvbv ≤ Q4(d)Ψ(h) such that the convergent tails at the target satisfy, for every l ≥ 0, X j≥l aj ∗eνj(U∗) v ≤ |a∗|l v exp((1 + l)bv). (3.3) (iv) If W ⊆ X is an irreducible algebraic variety containing z∗ on which a is nonconstant, then on every normalization branch above the generic point of every component of W ∩ V (a) the expressions E1, . . . , Es are not all identically zero. The expressions use their specified ordinary chart germs. Then h ≤ C1dC2 , with constants depending only on the fixed data and the polynomials in the hypotheses.
